name: How long does a metal roof replacement estimate take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does a metal roof replacement estimate take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, a metal roof replacement estimate can be completed within 1-2 hours on-site, depending on the size and complexity of your roof. Our team at Discounted Roofing Co. will schedule a convenient time to conduct a thorough inspection, gather necessary measurements, and discuss your specific needs and preferences. You can expect to receive a detailed estimate shortly after the on-site visit, often within 24-48 hours, allowing you to review it promptly.
acceptedAnswer.description: A metal roof replacement estimate usually takes 1-2 hours on-site, with a detailed estimate provided within 24-48 hours.
